'''Red Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in the [[Republic Army]] that was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]] in the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Red Squad was part of the forces deployed to infiltrate [[Broga's Palace]] and capture [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Dracen]], who had taken the palace as his own.<ref name="TOR" />
